item.title: Former US Air Force F-16 Pilot Arrested for Aiding China
item.description: China has aggressively sought to recruit former US military pilots to aid in understanding American air doctrine. The post Former US Air Force F-16 Pilot Arrested for Aiding China appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: How the White House Is Keeping Russia out of the South Caucasus
item.description: After successfully expanding US influence in Azerbaijan and Armenia, the Trump administration should set its sights on Georgia. The post How the White House Is Keeping Russia out of the South Caucasus appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Don’t Hold Your Breath on Iranian Democracy
item.description: Iran’s ethnic composition and political divisions suggest that a post-Islamic Republic environment would not be hospitable to liberal democracy. The post Don’t Hold Your Breath on Iranian Democracy appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: As America Readies to Strike Iran, Its Patriot Systems Are on Full Alert
item.description: The Patriot air defense system will probably be used to shoot down the missiles Iran fires in retaliation for strikes on its territory. The post As America Readies to Strike Iran, Its Patriot Systems Are on Full Alert appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The US Navy’s Submarines Are Getting a New Acoustic Decoy
item.description: The Acoustic Device Countermeasure, or ADC, is designed to mimic the sound of a submarine, diverting acoustic torpedoes to attack it rather than its host. The post The US Navy’s Submarines Are Getting a New Acoustic Decoy appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: China’s Port Investments in Israel Open the Door to Espionage
item.description: US Navy vessels can no longer dock at Israel’s northern port of Haifa without worrying that its Chinese-made cranes could be spying on them. The post China’s Port Investments in Israel Open the Door to Espionage appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: The Last Ship from the Falklands War Could Soon Be Scrapped
item.description: The RFA Argus, a British casualty receiving ship, is slated for retirement, then scrapping—but the Royal Navy has repeatedly dragged its heels on sending the ship to its grave. The post The Last Ship from the Falklands War Could Soon Be Scrapped appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Denmark Sold Its F-16s to Argentina Last Year. It Just Gave the Money to Ukraine.
item.description: The United States probably preferred the Danish sale to Argentina over a gift to Ukraine outright, as Buenos Aires is now tied to the US-made fighter jet. The post Denmark Sold Its F-16s to Argentina Last Year. It Just Gave the Money to Ukraine. appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Before It Gets Bigger, the US Navy Is Getting Smaller
item.description: This year, the US Navy has retired a handful of aging ships without immediate successors—shrinking its overall size, even amidst plans to expand it. The post Before It Gets Bigger, the US Navy Is Getting Smaller appeared first on The National Interest.

item.title: Who Will Succeed Ali Khamenei in Iran?
item.description: Ali Khamenei has dominated Iran’s clerical system for nearly four decades and sidelined all potential rivals—meaning there is no obvious choice for his successor. The post Who Will Succeed Ali Khamenei in Iran? appeared first on The National Interest.
